files.reason: Only start entry now invokes the independent process supervisor; formal commands directly invoke Python/Node fixtures and never execute npm start. No dependency lock or TLC budget changes.

New pure trusted CLI parser registry, dedicated-command JSON admin profile validation, optional exact provider ID/body fields, batch targets and moved documentBodies; empty default registry never treats stdout self-claims as authority. Direct old graph injection does not call parsers. Conservatively pin transitive module; no new parser-semantic proof claimed here.

Pure metadata now distinguishes unconfigured/empty/configured and match/no-match. Original graph actions never choose tools from this projection; runtime-binding has an empty catalog. No permission is granted by readiness.
New pure current-config metadata readiness projection, never execution authority; not called by finite direct-event drivers. Covered by native Runner/CLI configuration acceptance.

Adds host resource acquisition preflight. Existing synthetic formal goals contain no explicit acquisition URL or typed resourceRequirements, so requiredResources is empty; MapRecovery still checks complete source quotes. Actual URL/content receipt combinations remain separate KEJ113 model/BDD evidence.

Public dispatch/claim/start/CONSUME remain individual Store transactions. beginExecution reloads and validates the exact current attempt before committing its one-use permit; executionNotStarted accepts only authorized/cancelled-not-started phases and uses the trusted path, not public send. Post-dataErased deletion preparation now returns before creating any business transaction; deletion is absent from the old graph alphabet. Host-only recordAcquisition/notStarted and deletion settlement are new alphabets absent from old graphs. Recover includes ended cleanup; CancelledDiscussion updates Reopen/custody correspondence and keeps <=1 commit at clock0. New unsafe CLAIM atomically prechecks the global physical resource before charging, then the committed unsafe snapshot supplies its barrier. Existing graph CLAIM prefixes are safe; historical unsafe regression only checks retained/rejected old work, not this new acquisition lifecycle. Legacy workspace path remains exercised by Host and CancelledDiscussion; new RW resource-policy branch is independently tested, not claimed by legacy graph.
Trusted backend isolation marker only. Formal runtime binding aborts before spawn and direct engine graphs do not instantiate a CLI backend. No claim of OS confinement or process cleanup.

Adds optional trusted conflictKey/resourceLeases and LOCAL_PREPARED. All historical graph LOCAL_REQUEST prefixes omit the optional plan and retain legacy exclusive workspace leases and approval guards. New preparation/RW lifecycle is outside old graph and covered by dedicated model gates.

New pure conflict resource/RW lease resolver; legacy model prefixes intentionally omit resource plan, so new confinement/prepare-release cases have independent R25/R26 gates and actual Runtime integration. Pin dependency without claiming arbitrary RW/legacy composition.

Execute wrapper tracks actual physical jobs, optional owner manifests and optional prepared callback; historical runtime-binding uses no owner/resource plan and deliberately throws at started before spawn. Digest/approval/namespace/version checks remain. Host parsers/cleanup inventory are new I/O dependencies not invoked by direct coordination replay.

Prompt explains CLI readiness/verified method scope and directs owner/facilitator to actively complete authorized work with bounded alternatives and only essential human questions, preserving budget/deadline/approval/facts. E127 now passes host-generated canonical Web evidence IDs separately from untrusted page text; source operation IDs remain execution provenance. No finite driver calls model HTTP or this prompt; tool-choice and provider/stream liveness belong to real adapter acceptance.
Independent process watchdog model used by npm start wrapper; not invoked by finite TeamEngine drivers. New process failures, probes and OS restart are separate guarantees.

New pure host observation seal, source snapshot/resource identity/generation binding, requirement and artifact verification. Old graph synthetic goals have no typed/URL requirements, partitionResources or receipt events; exact selected acquisition references and current-versus-saved rules therefore remain outside their finite alphabet. New 20 resource paths and direct CLI/Web tests independently cover this new alphabet.

New deletion executor coordinates separate machine/storage/runtime custody; never constructed by these finite engine drivers. Room deletion protocol must not be inferred from old budget/authority verification.

New persisted destructive lifecycle; Store imports its pure helpers but no original graph submits REQUEST so deletion barrier is absent. Independent KEJ114 model/BDD handles confirmation/inventory/physical settlement/tombstones; original graphs do not prove it.

Adds bounded abort/drain/detach lifecycle, trusted no-start successor and acquisition recording, resource policy/prepared callbacks and fresh getter wiring. CLI-only deterministic result backfill before adapter/replay preserves original parentAttempt/finishedAt/sourceSnapshot; E126/Y71 model-first/native-CLI/dual-store completion checks cover the new cut window without reexecuting a settled command. These four old finite entrypoints directly call TeamEngine, except LocalRuntime pre-spawn binding; they never instantiate WorkRunner. New paths require independent real Runner/HTTP/SQLite acceptance, not expansion of old proof.

New optional pre-journal ownership manifest and cleanup inventory/removal. Original runtime-binding passes no owner and never reaches OS spawn; no original graph touches cleanup paths. Pin conservative dependency; actual filesystem ownership tested independently.

Transient HTTP/transport failures classified for bounded retry; auth/config remain explicit. No formal graph calls skills HTTP. Product finite retry model and native loopback adapter BDD cover this separately.

SourceItem claims require matching host acquisition. Typed documents bind original resource.id/content; URL documents require host-signed exact documentId, with strict default JSON identity/body fallback for generic web receipts. Custom provider fields are parsed once by the trusted reader, avoiding a mismatched second default parser. Old finite goals/artifacts contain no sourceItems, so sourceItemsProblem returns before changed checks; no source-item semantic guarantee added.

SqliteStore now accepts an optional borrowed DatabaseSync for WebService memory-mode consistency and closes only owned path connections. All four finite drivers retain the original string-path self-owned branch, so the borrowed connection/service close composition is independently covered by real memory WebService and deletion acceptance, not these old graphs. Adds deletion barrier/tombstone protocol and transactional RW leases alongside legacy workspace leases. All four finite drivers create no room deletion and legacy workspace graph requests have no resourceLeases. New transaction-local cross-room unsafe snapshot barriers quarantine generic adapter effects; these old graphs contain no unsafe physical resource claim, so dedicated two-store legacy-effects acceptance is separate. SQLite atomic helper preserves BEGIN IMMEDIATE/COMMIT rollback and MemoryStore snapshot commit semantics; explicit failure injection remains required. CancelledDiscussion observes actual acquire/release returns after commit, not inferred op text.

SUPERVISE actions invoke new pure resilience transitions. Existing graph alphabets do not emit SUPERVISE; canceled graph explicit public RECOVER remains separately projected. No new microstep is collapsed into a model I/O action.

Allows saved canceled help to be consumed after a logical terminal outcome, preserving saved material on explicit retry. Existing ReviewQueue models success/failed members and retry snapshots; cancellation/terminal retry composition remains a separately disclosed finite product scenario.
Adds persisted window/gates/cleanup initialized at openedAt. Existing model clocks are below default hard deadline and repair supervision due; no hidden automatic allowance or budget reset.

Explicit publishedDelivery is authoritative even on goal mismatch: mismatched records yield no publication instead of falling back to old final artifacts; legacy fallback without an explicit record and frozen-report precedence stay. All old finite publishedDelivery prefixes use the current goal; wrong-goal recovery input is separate A31 model/BDD. Requires acquired resources before submission/complete and projects immutable frozen incomplete publication. Old graphs use no URL/typed resource requirements; CheckBudget and MapRecovery still exercise ordinary mechanical/citation checks. Failed/stopped publication now host-freezes a report, which is outside old projected publication text.

Invitation and planning now ignore independently cleanup-owned uncertain work when computing content member availability. Old noncleanup discussion domains unchanged; CancelledDiscussion extends content-before-receipt paths and still rejects stale old results and conflicting physical claims. This fixes a real correspondence counterexample rather than permitting perpetual missing members.

Adds host web acquisitions to delivery evidence and immutable acquisition snapshots. Existing graph receipts are local runCli with saved stdout and no hostAcquisitions; their old evidence metadata/quote binding remains exercised. Web-only/local-disabled check is separate product model/BDD.

Member/lane eligibility excludes independently owned cleanup from uncertain logical work. CancelledDiscussion updates RoundIsolation to distinguish permitted new content from the still-held physical resource, and adds actual lease/custody variables; no weakening of physical exclusion.

Adds human/window/no-start/safe-repair guards and ignores independent cleanup at pure content boundaries. Old safe synthetic slices have no cleanup and preserve guards. CancelledDiscussion deliberately includes cleanup. Negative selectors updated at same activeHelp/deferred decisions, retaining behavior-target assertions.

Adds supervisor/human/no-start/receipt events and permits cancellation CLAIM in ended. STOP may end logically before external effects settle, so CancelledDiscussion no longer equates logical end with physical release. Existing WORK_FAILED synthetic transient rules/retry and ordinary claim/consume/check boundaries retained.

Adds shared prerequisite block, new verified-method reevaluation, typed per-partition acquisition references and logical skip; old 2-part graphs have no trusted method/failure-fingerprint facts, typed partitionResources or URL scopes, so those new branches and per-partition proof fields are absent. Deadline clamp is unchanged at finite clock0. More partitions/prerequisite scheduling remains independent model/BDD, not a TLC claim.

Web recovery now accepts only a canonical saved host acquisition ID whose source work/operation/request/content hash exactly matches delivery evidence; typed partition requirements query the actual original source owner without changing receipt ownership/attempt. Old MapRecovery has complete local runCli sources with no typed partition resource, so the original local eligibility/citation/independent-check branches remain. New actual Web provider JSON-only references and wrong-document controls are separately modeled and accepted. The old single generic unavailable-return mutant anchor became four returns after adding Web cases; select the exact existing missing/empty/stale source guard, retaining RecoveryEvidenceEligibility rather than replacing every new branch.

Capacity member eligibility now excludes independently owned cleanup from busy members, matching workLaneAvailable and discussion invitation. Existing no-cleanup capacity0/1/2/4 finite probes remain intact; new content-versus-physical responsibility is separately represented by CancelledDiscussion and the public resource-conflict probe.

Partition deadline is clamped to processing hard/repair window; old 2-part finite runs at clock0 have workTimeout below default global deadline and no repairDeadline. Assignment/init projection unchanged.

New pure prerequisite/method generation/config/resource semantics, including trusted same-generation/config Web authentication failures invalidating old verified methods; no old graph has two trusted prerequisite failures or acquired-method observations, so scheduling branches inactive. Old MapRecovery synthetic source still uses preexisting evidence/citation obligations; no implication that old graph proves new method selection.

continueOwner reuses only an original safe pending current-generation owner with a durable checkpoint and fully settled local operations, preserving original operation ownership/attempt/session/time. Old finite COORDINATE prefixes have no Runner-created checkpoint, so the fallback remains the existing owner creation; actual crash checkpoint handoff is separate finite model/native crash acceptance. Intent deadlines clamped, owner content path ignores independently owned cleanup, incomplete finish freezes deterministic report, complete finish rejects pending cleanup. CancelledDiscussion explicitly updates STOP/EXHAUSTED immediate custody while preserving known-result retirement and resource responsibility.

New trusted event gates, current deadline/window enforcement and CONTINUE cleanup exception. Finite clocks below deadlines preserve original budget/authority graph guards. Intentional change: cleanup-owned unknown effects permit new content, while original op authorization/lease remain immutable; CancelledDiscussion revised and negative controls strengthened.

CancelledDiscussion updates immediate Cancel and RECOVER while retaining canceled safe retirement, trusted receipt retirement and old-round rejection. Candidate replay found frozen RECOVER skipped safe retirement; product owner fixed it before acceptance, retained as a real bug rather than relaxing property.

Old four graphs do not emit HUMAN_GATE_DECISION or clarification analyses; the public-model/service prefix is independently checked. New persisted finite supervision, skip, human gate, cleanup ownership and deterministic incomplete finish. CancelledDiscussion now represents immediate physical custody, content continuation before receipt and actual legacy lease retention; other old graphs execute below fixed deadlines without supervisor events. Newly added repair/provider failure permutations remain separate executable real taskMachine gates.
